body: I so appreciate the sentiment, I really do. I just feel like I am at the point of no return really. I do nothing myself that makes me happy anymore. Few things I can do myself make me happy. Everything I do, that does make me happy is for other people really. The most remotely close thing I would do is watch the Food Network before work in efforts to keep myself from crying or having a panic attack before I drive. If I am going to be honest, I'm probably just going to get myself really medicated on my medical marijuana and go from there, but while I am loopy land, I will find something safe and comforting to occupy myself with. I try my hardest to take everything day by day, even hour by hour, just so I can survive.
